name: read_section
description: Read ONLY a specific markdown section (under a heading) of a note, saving up to 95% of tokens compared to reading the full file.

path_or_title.description: Relative path or note title (e.g. 'app-prod-01' or '04 - Servidores/app-prod-01.md').

heading.description: Heading text of the section to retrieve (e.g. 'Acesso e Conectividade' or 'Serviços Hospedados').
